eligibility: reconciled cash flows; positive net return; sampled mark drawdown <= 10%; >=8 trades. Highest validation net return wins. This screening rule was adopted after validation and before holdout, not preregistered before validation.
exploratory_reason: 6 trades in validation, all ZEC; below minimum sample count
holdout: Run all 13 unchanged variants; do not replace the primary with the best holdout performer
risk_limit_note: 10% is a research screening threshold, not a live risk setting or promise
